script.title: Why Your Website Is Losing Customers to Slow Load Times — Reel 3

segments.text: YOUR SLOW SITE IS COSTING YOU CALLS
segments.narration: If your business website takes more than 2.5 seconds to load on a phone, Google flags it as slow.

segments.text: 54% CHECK YOUR SITE AFTER READING REVIEWS
segments.narration: In 2026, 54 percent of local consumers visit a business website after reading positive reviews. Most of them are on a phone. A slow page means they leave before they see your number.
Go to pagespeed dot web dot dev and enter your URL. You get a mobile score in 30 seconds. Anything below 50 is costing you customers right now.
Send this to a local business owner who hasn't checked their site speed yet.
